dataset_title: European digestate compositional properties — Zenodo v1 row-level reference extract
license: CC BY 4.0 (license verified in Ghent University Biblio record for the publication/data package)
source_row_count_note: 1884 rows with numeric digestate category codes were retained from the v1 workbook. This is not asserted to equal the paper's screened Database A/C sample size; the workbook has code legends and incomplete rows, and v2 is a different Zenodo release.
geography: European Biogas Association registry data collected through national biogas associations in Austria, Germany, Finland, France, and the United Kingdom, as described by Reuland et al. (2021).
source_locations: Workbook sheet Untitled2; row numbers retained in source_excel_row.
Reuland et al. (2021), Materials and Methods §§2.1.1–2.2.4; Table 1 and Table 2.

feedstock_group_code.2: biowaste and manure and/or energy crops

variable_units_and_bases.pH: dimensionless; reported method may be pH-KCl for the paper's campaign measurements, not necessarily every registry row
variable_units_and_bases.TOC: g/kg dry matter; note that the paper derives some Database A TOC values using a 0.55 TOC/OM factor
variable_units_and_bases.CaO: g/kg dry matter; paper-wide unit harmonization applies, but this field is not summarized in Table 1
variable_units_and_bases.Mg: g/kg dry matter; paper-wide unit harmonization applies, but this field is not summarized in Table 1
variable_units_and_bases.Cr, Cd, Pb, Zn, Cu, Hg, Ni, Sn, Fe, Mn: mg/kg dry matter where reported; verify source-specific field conventions before use
variable_units_and_bases.E_Coli, Salmonella, Endoparasitis, Viabl: unit and reporting basis not resolved in the workbook/article fields used for this extract; values are retained verbatim and must not be used quantitatively

data_handling: A faithful row extract of numeric-coded observations from the licensed v1 workbook. Original columns and values are retained; four helper columns add an internal row ID, original Excel row, and explicit category labels. No imputation, unit conversion, aggregation, outlier removal, or recalculation was applied. Blank cells remain blank.
limitations: The dataset is mixed European digestate evidence and is not specific to roadside grass, grass-only digestion, or GreenHub's post-protein residual stream.
The paper states the EBA registry did not identify separation technology; digestate/liquid-fraction interpretation may depend on dry-matter ranges rather than verified process labels.
The sheet contains broad feedstock groups and cannot isolate a grass-only observation cohort.
The v1 workbook row count does not match the later v2 Zenodo record's stated n=1895; versions must not be merged or represented as equivalent.
Microbial/pathogen and weed-seed units are unresolved and retained for traceability only.
Not suitable for GreenHub runtime defaults, component balances, fertilizer substitution credits, product-grade decisions, or process recovery yields.
suggested_use: Contextual Phase 7 comparator for broad digestate nutrient-composition ranges and validation of future grass-specific measurements; do not use as a GreenHub model input or to parameterize recovery performance.
normalization: No value normalization. Published unit/basis notes are metadata only and are not applied as runtime conversions.
repository_v2_note: Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.7104262 is a later, distinct version whose record did not expose a license field during this review; this extract is from the independently identified v1 file and is not attributed to v2.
